The report aims to address the gap in important climate change discussions, which often exclude the voices of the communities most affected by the issue [2]. Key findings from the research include:
* Residents of color are more likely than white residents to believe that climate change is happening in Massachusetts and is a very serious threat.
* White respondents are the least inclined to view climate change impacts as affecting some people more than others.
